# Apple typography style reference

Observed from the public Apple home page on 2026-08-24. This is style guidance
only; Apple images and fonts are not copied or distributed by LumaText.

| Role | Public CSS font stack | Size | Weight | Line height | Letter spacing |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Body | `SF Pro Text, SF Pro Icons, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif` | 17 px | 400 | 25 px | -0.374 px |
| Primary tile title | `SF Pro Display, SF Pro Icons, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif` | 56 px | 600 | 60 px | -0.28 px |
| Primary tile subhead | same display stack | 28 px | 400 | 32 px | 0.196 px |
| Compact tile title | same display stack | 40 px | 600 | 44 px | normal |
| Compact tile subhead | same display stack | 21 px | 400 | 25 px | 0.231 px |
| Standard action | text stack | 17 px | 400 | 20 px | -0.374 px |
| Compact action | text stack | 14 px | 400 | 18 px | -0.224 px |

The useful direction for LumaText is restrained optical weight, fractional
spacing, grayscale edges, and distinct real 400/600/700 faces. The numerical
acceptance source remains CoreText rendering of the pinned Noto Sans CJK
2.004 files on `macos-15`, not a Windows browser screenshot and not SF Pro.
